claim: Bagnoud et al. analyzed whole-blood transcriptomes in MS relapse and reported genes associated with glucocorticoid-sensitive versus glucocorticoid-resistant response.
future_grounding_route: If expression data and labels are accessible, use the reported glucocorticoid-resistance context to stress-test the V32 steroid confounder panel; until rerun, keep as external context only.

project_finding_reference.finding_id: V22 scalar is immune-tone bounded, not steroid/composition artifact

project_use: Sharper V50 source record for steroid-responsiveness heterogeneity in MS blood transcriptomes.
relationship_note: This source directly supports the relevance of glucocorticoid-response heterogeneity as a confounder-risk class, but it does not evaluate the V22 score.

source.citation: Bagnoud M, Remlinger J, Joly S, et al. Predicting glucocorticoid resistance in multiple sclerosis relapse via a whole blood transcriptomic analysis. CNS Neuroscience & Therapeutics. 2024;30:e14484.
source.label: Bagnoud 2024 glucocorticoid resistance whole-blood transcriptomics

source_terms.license_or_terms_label: Open-access article; metadata-only reuse in V50
source_terms.reuse_notes: V50 stores source metadata and a short paraphrased claim only; underlying data are not imported here.

why_unverifiable: The project has not rerun the Bagnoud et al. transcriptomic analysis or evaluated the V22 scalar against those response labels.
